measurement.metric_semantics: A span is only an acceptance proxy for sustained useful work when continuous-progress evidence is also present; two sparse timestamps separated by idle time must never count as 14 minutes of work.
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: For a valid acceptance turn, ordered meaningful durable progress evidence must cover the run from substantive start through final progress with no unexplained internal gap greater than 120 seconds. Known waiting/idle intervals are excluded or invalidate the continuous-work claim.
measurement.dead_tail_definition: successor_or_handoff_boundary_at - last_meaningful_progress_at when both are known
measurement.target_operating_model: ~840s evidenced sustained useful work + ~60s runtime-safe handoff margin inside each intended 900s interval
measurement.platform_boundary_note: Official Scheduled Tasks documentation describes paid recurring schedules up to once per hour. The quarter-hour fast path is experimental same-task hourly-BYMINUTE mutation, so actual successor observation rather than nominal due time controls measurement validity.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Epoch 15 claimed WORKING authority from 00:15:05 through the next successor wake, but TURN_PLAN remained TEMPLATE_PENDING_NEXT_AUTHORITY with objective NEXT-WAKE-MUST-ASSIGN. The plan-first intervention was therefore adopted in policy but never instantiated by the active owner, and ACTIVITY also had no progress after 00:15:05.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: Policy prose cannot guarantee utilization. Runtime-valid state must make an unplanned WORKING owner invalid and preserve explicit plan progress/outcome evidence.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: If WORKING authority is machine-invalid unless TURN_PLAN is a real ACTIVE plan for the same owner/epoch, and plan progress/outcome is validated durably, the system will prevent silent policy-only plan adoption and expose premature return immediately.
next_corrective_experiment.change: Strengthen control-plane validation around TURN_PLAN owner/epoch/status/objective, add explicit progress/outcome evidence, and classify premature return rather than leaving a template or stale WORKING state.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Validator passes only with a real active plan for the owner; next live worker executes that plan with <=120s meaningful progress gaps and finalizes handoff/measurement explicitly.
